These rules do update automatically when you have `mode` set to `AAG`. Contact your account team to access this option. Use `alert` to record the trigger of the event, `deny` to block the request, or `none` to take no action. _Products:_ Kona Site Defender, App & API Protector with the Advanced Security module.
